dependent_variable.unit: one value per frozen reader-fit donor
dependent_variable.identity_constraint: nuisance_y is bytewise-numeric-equal to overall_A after float64 conversion

test_object.coefficient: intercept beta[0] from equal-donor OLS on intercept plus centered retained nuisance columns

hc3.hat: diag(X @ inverse(X.T@X) @ X.T), implemented by einsum

inference.p_value: positive one-sided Student-t survival probability at beta0/SE, report only for this gate
inference.gate: hc3_nuisance_positive passes iff estimable and two-sided lower bound > 0

fail_closed_behavior.collinearity: nuisance_design retains only sorted centered columns that increase numerical rank; selected frozen X must independently remain rank 16
fail_closed_behavior.source_confined: separate cross_source_replication gate requires the two-sided lower bound > 0 in each HVS, NPH52, and SEA_AD donor group; it is not folded into HC3

legal_boundary: type(legal) is bool and only literal True passes
resolution: The existing truth table and code uniquely determine the donor outcome, evidence level, HC3 arithmetic, inference convention, and PASS/VETO mapping. No new statistical mapping is introduced.
